export default function ParcelBox({ p, c, sw, uid }: { p: Record<string, number>; c: Record<string, string>; sw: number; uid: string }) {
  const lid = p.lid ?? 0;
  const open = (1 - lid) * 60;
  const tape = lid;
  return (
    <g strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
      <defs>
        <radialGradient id={`${uid}-b`} cx="35%" cy="30%" r="80%">
          <stop offset="0" stopColor={c.white} stopOpacity={0.55} />
          <stop offset="1" stopColor={c.surface2} />
        </radialGradient>
        <radialGradient id={`${uid}-l`} cx="35%" cy="30%" r="80%">
          <stop offset="0" stopColor={c.white} stopOpacity={0.6} />
          <stop offset="1" stopColor={c.surface} />
        </radialGradient>
        <radialGradient id={`${uid}-t`} cx="35%" cy="30%" r="80%">
          <stop offset="0" stopColor={c.white} stopOpacity={0.5} />
          <stop offset="1" stopColor={c.accent} />
        </radialGradient>
        <radialGradient id={`${uid}-s`} cx="35%" cy="30%" r="80%">
          <stop offset="0" stopColor={c.white} stopOpacity={0.5} />
          <stop offset="1" stopColor={c.primary} />
        </radialGradient>
      </defs>
      <ellipse cx={100} cy={172} rx={66} ry={9} fill={c.black} opacity={0.15} />
      <rect x={34} y={80} width={132} height={88} rx={14} fill={`url(#${uid}-b)`} stroke={c.border} strokeWidth={sw} />
      <g transform={`rotate(${-open} 34 80)`}>
        <rect x={30} y={56} width={70} height={24} rx={10} fill={`url(#${uid}-l)`} stroke={c.border} strokeWidth={sw} />
      </g>
      <g transform={`rotate(${open} 166 80)`}>
        <rect x={100} y={56} width={70} height={24} rx={10} fill={`url(#${uid}-l)`} stroke={c.border} strokeWidth={sw} />
      </g>
      <rect x={90} y={56} width={20} height={Math.max(0.1, 24 + 70 * tape)} rx={8} fill={`url(#${uid}-t)`} stroke={c.border} strokeWidth={sw} opacity={tape > 0.02 ? 1 : 0} />
      <path d="M100 138 L100 138" stroke={c.border} strokeWidth={sw} />
      <path d="M126 122 L152 122 L152 140 Q152 154 139 160 Q126 154 126 140 Z" fill={`url(#${uid}-s)`} stroke={c.border} strokeWidth={sw} />
      <path d="M132 139 L137 145 L147 133" fill="none" stroke={c.onPrimary} strokeWidth={sw} />
    </g>
  );
}
